messages:
Priya Nair: quick heads-up from Day0 dry-run with Arcturus private deploy — SOC flagged two issues: egress flow logs are being sampled at 0.1% and audit entries for KMS decrypt calls in our ingest don't show keyId. customer is worried this will block their audit and become a renewal risk.
Ben Cho: can you paste one of the raw lines so we can see the fields?
Priya Nair: pasted below (sanitized). note the missing keyId field and sample_rate header.
```json
{"time":"2026-03-20T15:12:03Z","src_ip":"10.5.2.14","dst_ip":"52.14.22.3","event":"flow","sample_rate":0.001,"audit":{"action":"kms:Decrypt","username":"svc-app","key_alias":"alias/arcturus-prod-v1"}}
```
Marta Lopes: if the pipeline relies on keyId instead of alias we lose a stable identifier post-rotation. their KMS rotation policy rotates the alias target every 7 days (they wanted weekly key rotation). we need to confirm whether our ingest enrichment derives keyId from alias or from header.
Jared Kim: for telemetry sampling during dry-runs we typically set sample_rate to 1.0 for 48h. i can add a temporary rule on the agent side and push a small agent config change to the privnet. i'll open a PR and flag it to eng-oncall.
Ben Cho: i can check Splunk index mapping — if audit events are parsed via alias we can map alias->keyId in the enrichment step. if not, i'll add an enrichment hook that calls the KMS metadata service (cached) to expand alias to keyId.
onboard-bot: Created ticket CS-4521: "Arcturus telemetry sampling & KMS keyId enrichment" (prio: high).
Priya Nair: action items: 1) Jared to bump sampling to 1.0 for 48h and submit PR (CS-4521) 2) Ben to validate Splunk ingestion mapping and add alias->keyId enrichment if needed (CS-4521) 3) Marta to confirm whether customer's KMS rotation window can be moved to 14d for audit stability or if we should implement a stable envelope id in logs (CS-4521) 4) Priya to notify customer and update renewal health score. target: EOD Thu.
Marta Lopes: quick note — if we implement enrichment, ensure we redact no-sensitive fields and cache lookups for 24h to avoid KMS throttling.
Jared Kim: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/priv-agent/pulls/789 — will deploy to staging in 30m, pinging eng-oncall.
Ben Cho: mapping check done — current parsing uses alias in field `kms_alias`. i'll add enrichment that writes kms_key_id and keep kms_alias for traceability. will test in staging after jared's deploy.
Priya Nair: thanks everyone. i'll message the customer with the plan and escalate to AM if we see any pushback on rotation cadence. marking this thread: follow-up tracked in CS-4521. :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: (after deploy) small follow-up — sampling bumped and enrichment landed in staging. will run 24h soak then schedule production cutover. noted for renewal health: temporarily moved from "at risk" to "watch".
